findings.claim: The repair's own census move (18 in-class -> 17) did not propagate to ADR-038 §f, which still says R2 was 'measured sound on all 18 here' — contradicting the front matter and the §f row directly above it, and falsifying the resolution's 'no stale census / count / roster claim survives anywhere' sweep claim.
findings.evidence: ADR-038:778 — 'the two-layer split assumes segmentation is sound on this shape; it is measured sound on all 18 here'. The same file :12 says three defect + 'the other 14 in-class items correct' = 17 in-class, :736 says 'the census moves to 17 items across 6 filings, not 18', and :774 (the row immediately above) already reads 'the fourteen correct verdicts'. The line is byte-identical to 3ed9003 (pre-repair :648) — the pre-repair count left behind. pr60-r1-resolution.json's sweep greps only 'all 45 dev|18/6|18 items across 6|18 across 6|eleven `correct`|7/7A/8/15', none of which matches 'all 18 here', so the sweep reported clean on a surviving stale count.
findings.acceptance: ADR-038:778 reads 'all 17' (or names the set it means), and the propagation sweep is re-run with a pattern that matches a bare 'all 18'/'18 here', not only the '18/6' spellings.

findings.claim: The new 'prong 1 cannot be a length test' derivation publishes a wrong char count (110; it is 111) and claims all three §b3 rejections were 'measured the same way' as the xom bodies, when the intc-2002 figure is a hand sub-split INSIDE a sentence the named instrument does not split — and 'no threshold separates them from 176' only holds under that undisclosed split.
findings.evidence: ADR-038:730-735, re-published at ADR-034:227 and tasks/TODO.md:1002. ORCHESTRATOR-VERIFIED both limbs: (a) the quoted string is 111 chars, not 110. (b) d13_span_dump.py --prong1 segments intc-2002 item 5 as [0] 201, [1] 359, [2] 5 — sentence [1] is ONE splitter unit containing BOTH the pointer clause and the 111-char holder sentence; ba-2003's 74/145/89 and textron-2001's 104/86 ARE splitter sentences, so 'measured the same way' is false for exactly the item carrying the load-bearing minimum. (c) Under the instrument's own segmentation the three rejections span 190..359, so a threshold of ~180 WOULD reject all three while admitting xom-2021 item 8's 176 — 'no threshold separates them' is true only under the sub-sentence split, which the ADR does not disclose. (d) --prong1's output is not committed and is absent from ADR-038's Verification list (:872-877 lists only --table and --auditor-input), which is why an off-by-one in a retyped figure survived — the exact failure mode the script's own docstring says it exists to prevent.
findings.acceptance: The figure reads 111 in all three surfaces; §e3 states that intc-2002's standalone content is a hand sub-split inside splitter sentence [1] (359 chars) rather than 'measured the same way'; and either the 'no threshold separates them' sentence is qualified with that dependence, or --prong1's output is committed (as --table/--auditor-input are) and listed in Verification so the numbers are derived rather than retyped.
